Officer's narrative
Driver 1 was traveling through the signalized intersection when the vehicle was struck on the driver side by Driver 2,
who had entered the intersection from a cross street. The impact was a broadside collision, and both vehicles came
to rest near the northwest corner. Driver 1 reported pain in the left shoulder and was transported for evaluation. The
injury pattern is consistent with the force and direction of the side impcat observed at the scene. Damage to the
struck vehicle is concentrated along the driver door, quarter panel and intrusion into the door frame, which matches
the described impact. Driver 2 acknowledged the sequence of events at the scene, and two independent witnesses
gave statements that agree with that account. Photographs taken at the scene show debris and damage consistent
with the collision. Responding officers confirmed that a Passenger was seated in the vehicle at the time, and no prior
damage to the vehicle was noted during inspection. Driver 1 is listed as the named insured on the policy covering the
vehicle.
